examples.arabic: اليوم عم نحكي عن المدرسة الابتدائية ياللي تحولت لملجأ للعائلات النازحة.
examples.english: Today we are talking about the primary school that turned into a shelter for displaced families.
examples.transliteration: el-yawm am nihki an el-madrase el-ibtidaiyye yalli t-hawwalet la-malja la-l-aylat el-nazha.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: مع إنه الأصوات البعيدة مخيفة، الأطفال عم بيلعبوا بساحة المدرسة.
examples.english: Even though the distant sounds are scary, the children are playing in the school courtyard.
examples.transliteration: Ma inno el aswat el baeedeh mukhifeh el atfal am biyilabu bi sahat el madraseh.
examples.storyTitle: Voice of Hope from the Radio

examples.arabic: اليوم بروح ع المدرسة مع ابني و بنتي
examples.english: Today I go to school with my son and my daughter.
examples.transliteration: al yom brooh a al madrasa ma ibni wa binti

examples.english: In the morning, Sami wants to get dressed for school.

examples.arabic: حاولت اصلحها طول النهار بس بلا فايدة واكيد اولادك رح يجو من المدرسة وعم بيرجفوا من البرد
examples.english: I tried to fix it all day but to no avail, and surely your children will come from school shivering from the cold.
examples.transliteration: Ḥāwalt aṣalliḥha ṭūl an-nahār bas bilā fāyde w akīd awlādak raḥ yiju min il madrasa w ʿam biyirjifu min il bard.

examples.arabic: بعد المدرسة رجعت عالبيت مع ماما
examples.english: After school I returned home with Mom.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd al madrasa raja't al beit ma'a mama
